items.title: How Russia became the 'FSB state': 'They were given the country'
items.description: 'The Putin System' (2/3). Russia's next elections, from September 18 to 20, are set to have no real stakes in a country silenced by the Federal Security Service, whose powers have continued to grow unchecked since the invasion of Ukraine.

items.title: Middle East live: Saudi Arabia accuses Houthi rebels of launching a drone strike on Mecca
items.description: Saudi Arabia's air defences claimed to have intercepted and destroyed a Houthi drone south of Mecca on Tuesday, which the Iran-aligned rebels denied. Meanwhile, several explosions were heard on the island of Qeshm, near the Strait of Hormuz. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.

items.title: The Palestinian school under siege – podcast
items.description: At least five pupils at a village school in the West Bank have been killed in the last year by settlers and soldiers. Emma Graham-Harrison reports on how the school found itself on the frontline, while a teacher explains what life is like for staff and students.Waheed Abu Naim is an English teacher at the Al Mughayyir …

items.title: DRC-Rwanda: Can Geneva talks break the cycle of war in eastern Congo?
items.description: M23 controls large parts of eastern DRC as Kinshasa and Kigali remain divided over security and sovereignty.

items.title: Ukraine Reports 219 Frontline Clashes as Fighting Intensifies Near Pokrovsk
items.description: The General Staff of the Armed Forces of Ukraine (AFU) reported 219 combat engagements by 10 p.m. local time on Tuesday, Sept. 15, with the heaviest fighting concentrated on the Pokrovsk axis. Russian forces reportedly launched 68 airstrikes, dropped 249 guided aerial bombs (KABs) and deployed 4,153 loitering munitions…

items.title: British woman abducted in Malawi, police say
items.description: The mother of two young children was kidnapped in the middle of the day in the main city, Blantyre.

items.title: A Quiet Ukrainian Counteroffensive, A 'Rout' For Russian Forces
items.description: By most accounts, the Ukrainian counteroffensive is shaping up to be one of the largest shifts on the battlefield in months, possibly in a year.

items.title: MFA Repeats Warning for Foreign Embassies in Kyiv to Evacuate After Train Strike Near Poland
items.description: The ministry accused Western politicians of “blatantly ignoring” the warnings of their own governments against visiting war-torn Ukraine.

items.title: 'Woman, Life, Freedom' spirit lives on as Iran war drags on
items.description: The 2022 death of Jina Mahsa Amini in police custody triggered a resistance movement in Iran. Four years later, the Iranian regime endures — but so does the legacy of the "Woman, Life, Freedom" protests.

items.title: Six UN staff killed in Gaza school strike; Lebanon violations mount
items.description: Israeli strikes killed six UN workers and civilians at a school sheltering displaced families in Gaza as needs grow, according to the UN agency for Palestine refugees, UNRWA.
